name: aurapay
description: AuraPay — stablecoin-to-local-payments network. Spend digital money; recipients receive KES.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @aurapay/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @aurapay/shared" "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aurapay/shared && npm run build -w @aurapay/api && npm run build -w @aurapay/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aurapay/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @aurapay/api && npm run test -w @aurapay/shared
